narrator.stanley.name: Stanley
narrator.stanley.desc: The everyman, confused by your choices
narrator.nigel.name: Nigel
narrator.nigel.desc: Tries to guide you, often frustrated
narrator.malcolm.name: Malcolm
narrator.edgar.name: Edgar
narrator.chester.name: Chester
narrator.reginald.name: Reginald
narrator.stanley.block_break.1: Stanley broke a block. How productive.
narrator.stanley.block_break.2: Another block gone. Stanley's making progress... probably.
narrator.stanley.block_break.3: Breaking blocks. That's what Stanley does best.
narrator.stanley.block_break.4: The block didn't stand a chance against Stanley.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.1: Stanley walked into a new biome. How adventurous.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.2: The scenery changed. Stanley didn't seem to notice.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.3: A new biome. Stanley wondered if this one would be different.
narrator.stanley.biome_enter.4: The biome shifted. Stanley continued walking.
narrator.stanley.death.1: Stanley died. This was not part of the plan.
narrator.stanley.death.2: And so Stanley's journey came to an abrupt end.
narrator.stanley.death.3: Death found Stanley. Stanley did not appreciate this.
narrator.stanley.death.4: The narrator watched Stanley die. The narrator felt nothing.
narrator.stanley.combat.1: Stanley was fighting for his life.
narrator.stanley.combat.2: The creature attacked. Stanley defended. It was chaos.
narrator.stanley.combat.3: Combat. Stanley was not prepared for this.
narrator.stanley.idle.1: Stanley stood still. The narrator waited.
narrator.stanley.idle.2: Nothing happened. The narrator grew impatient.
narrator.stanley.idle.3: Stanley wasn't doing anything. This was boring.
narrator.stanley.idle.4: The silence was deafening. Stanley did nothing.
narrator.stanley.achievement.1: Stanley achieved something. The narrator took notes.
narrator.stanley.achievement.2: An achievement. Stanley was making progress after all.
narrator.stanley.achievement.3: The narrator acknowledged Stanley's accomplishment. Briefly.
narrator.stanley.achievement.4: Stanley earned an achievement. How industrious.
narrator.nigel.block_break.1: Good job! You broke a block. Keep going!
narrator.nigel.block_break.2: That block was in your way. Problem solved!
narrator.nigel.block_break.3: Mining is a noble profession. Keep at it!
narrator.nigel.block_break.4: Every block broken is progress made!
narrator.nigel.biome_enter.1: Oh, a new biome! Look around, there might be resources here!
narrator.nigel.biome_enter.2: You've entered a new area. Explore carefully!
narrator.nigel.biome_enter.4: The scenery changed! This could be exciting!
narrator.nigel.death.1: Oh no! Don't worry, we'll try again!
narrator.nigel.death.2: That didn't go as planned. Let's learn from this!
narrator.nigel.death.3: Everyone dies sometimes. It's part of the journey!
narrator.nigel.death.4: Unfortunate. But every failure is a lesson!
narrator.nigel.idle.1: Are you okay? You seem to be standing still.
narrator.nigel.achievement.2: Well done! That's a great accomplishment!
narrator.nigel.achievement.3: You did it! I'm so proud of you!
narrator.nigel.achievement.4: Achievement unlocked! Keep up the great work!
narrator.malcolm.block_break.1: Wow. You broke a block. Truly groundbreaking.
narrator.malcolm.block_break.2: Another block destroyed. Your legacy grows.
narrator.malcolm.block_break.4: The block is gone. Are you happy now?
narrator.malcolm.biome_enter.1: Oh look, a new biome. I'm sure this one will be different.
narrator.malcolm.biome_enter.3: A new biome. Because the last one was boring, right?
narrator.malcolm.biome_enter.4: Welcome to somewhere else. It's all the same really.
narrator.malcolm.death.1: And there it is. I was wondering when that would happen.
narrator.malcolm.death.3: You died. The narrator is not surprised.
narrator.malcolm.death.4: Death: the one thing you're consistent at.
narrator.malcolm.combat.1: Oh, you're fighting. This should be entertaining.
narrator.malcolm.combat.2: Combat. Let's see how this goes.
narrator.malcolm.combat.3: A battle. How thrilling. I'll wait.
narrator.malcolm.idle.2: Are you going to do something, or...?
narrator.malcolm.idle.3: The narrator waits. And waits. And waits.
narrator.malcolm.achievement.1: An achievement. I suppose that's something.
narrator.malcolm.achievement.2: You got an achievement. Do you want a medal?
narrator.malcolm.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked. The narrator is underwhelmed.
narrator.edgar.block_break.1: The block crumbled. Like everything else.
narrator.edgar.block_break.3: Another piece of the world, gone forever.
narrator.edgar.block_break.4: The earth weeps as you tear it apart.
narrator.edgar.biome_enter.1: You've entered a place of shadows. Be wary.
narrator.edgar.biome_enter.2: The biome shifted. Something watches here.
narrator.edgar.biome_enter.4: The land changed. It remembers you.
narrator.edgar.death.1: Death comes for us all. Today it came for you.
narrator.edgar.death.2: The end. As it was always going to be.
narrator.edgar.death.3: You fell. The darkness is patient.
narrator.edgar.death.4: Another soul claimed. The cycle continues.
narrator.edgar.combat.1: Blood will be spilled. It is inevitable.
narrator.edgar.combat.2: The creatures hunger. They always do.
narrator.edgar.combat.3: Fight if you wish. It changes nothing.
narrator.edgar.idle.3: The stillness is deafening. Something approaches.
narrator.edgar.achievement.1: An achievement. The darkness takes notice.
narrator.edgar.achievement.2: You earned something. But at what cost?
narrator.edgar.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked. The shadows grow longer.
narrator.edgar.achievement.4: An accomplishment. The void acknowledges you.
narrator.chester.block_break.1: You broke a block! That's the spirit!
narrator.chester.block_break.2: Mining away! What a beautiful day!
narrator.chester.block_break.4: Blocks are meant to be broken! Keep going!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.1: A new biome! Isn't nature wonderful?!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.2: Look at this beautiful place! Everything is amazing!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.3: New adventures! New possibilities! Life is good!
narrator.chester.biome_enter.4: The world is full of wonders! Explore them all!
narrator.chester.death.1: You died! But hey, at least you tried!
narrator.chester.death.2: Death is just a new beginning! How exciting!
narrator.chester.death.3: Oops! Well, nobody's perfect! Let's go again!
narrator.chester.death.4: You fell! But the important thing is you had fun!
narrator.chester.combat.1: A battle! What an exciting opportunity!
narrator.chester.combat.2: Fight with joy in your heart!
narrator.chester.combat.3: Combat! Every moment is a gift!
narrator.chester.idle.1: Resting! Good for you! Self-care is important!
narrator.chester.idle.4: Life is beautiful! Even when you're doing nothing!
narrator.chester.achievement.1: AN ACHIEVEMENT! THIS IS THE BEST DAY EVER!
narrator.chester.achievement.2: YOU DID IT! I KNEW YOU COULD!
narrator.chester.achievement.4: WOW! AN ACHIEVEMENT! I'M SO HAPPY FOR YOU!
narrator.reginald.block_break.1: I told you to break that block. You're welcome.
narrator.reginald.block_break.2: Another block broken, thanks to my guidance.
narrator.reginald.block_break.3: You broke a block. I deserve credit for this.
narrator.reginald.block_break.4: Mining. I would've done it better, but still.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.1: I chose this biome for you. You should be grateful.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.2: A new biome. I planned this all along.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.3: Welcome to my masterpiece. Look around.
narrator.reginald.biome_enter.4: The biome changed. I made that happen.
narrator.reginald.death.3: You fell. I could've prevented that. I chose not to.
narrator.reginald.combat.1: Fight well. I'm watching. Taking notes.
narrator.reginald.combat.2: Combat. I could win this in my sleep.
narrator.reginald.combat.3: Show me what you've learned from me.
narrator.reginald.combat.4: Battle. I've seen better. But try.
narrator.reginald.idle.1: Standing still. Waiting for my next brilliant instruction.
narrator.reginald.idle.2: Idle. Even I need a break from being perfect.
narrator.reginald.idle.3: Nothing happens. The narrator is still the best.
narrator.reginald.idle.4: Waiting. I have all the time in the world.
narrator.reginald.achievement.1: An achievement. I taught you everything you know.
narrator.reginald.achievement.2: You earned something. I deserve the credit.
narrator.reginald.achievement.3: Achievement unlocked. My guidance paid off.
narrator.reginald.achievement.4: Congratulations to me for your achievement.
